name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including its private notes. The compact doc-client-note-open entry opens a modal prefilled with email subject, email body, WhatsApp, and ordered custom title/content notes; applying changes participates in the unsaved guard, and save persists the complete collection. Failed or rejected saves retain the notes draft, while issued collection accounts expose it read-only. The existing content/status, client/project association, backlinks, Markdown clipboard toolbar, template-style preview, and dual PDF download remain available.
